label: insufficient_evidence
rationale: Icotrokinra UC protocol provides no EMC tumor-scope evidence or explicit cancer exclusion in saved criteria.
cohort_reconciliation: Adult blinded induction/maintenance and adolescent open-label induction/maintenance, including extension, remain ulcerative-colitis cohorts.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol prior-treatment definitions and extension criteria unavailable; cancer comorbidity applicability unestablished.
quotes: Diagnosis of ulcerative colitis (UC) established at least 12 weeks before screening

label: insufficient_evidence
rationale: Unlisted STS may be considered by the coordinating investigator, but 'Chondrosarcoma' is expressly excluded without clarification whether this includes extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma. Do not resolve that taxonomy ambiguity from the broad STS title.
cohort_reconciliation: Completed safety run-in and randomized trabectedin versus trabectedin/tTF-NGR phase III use shared histology/CD13 scope. No separate EMC cohort resolves the exclusion.
extra_biomarker_requirement: Central CD13 positivity score at least 1 is required and unestablished for EMC; cannot be assumed from general STS expression rationale.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol and trabectedin attachment unavailable; coordinating-investigator clarification needed for EMC versus generic chondrosarcoma exclusion. Source reports safety run-in completion and approval-dependent randomized opening, but live approvals/slots not independently checked. Source safety claims are not validated here.
quotes: Tumor types not listed above may be included upon communication with Coordinating Investigator.
CD13 positivity with a score of ≥ 1

label: explicit_exclusion
rationale: DSRCT histology plus EWSR1-WT1 is required; EWSR1 alone or EMC's NR4A3 fusion cannot meet that disease/fusion restriction.
cohort_reconciliation: Single lurbinectedin/irinotecan cohort in second-to-fourth-line DSRCT; optional biological substudy does not broaden disease eligibility.
extra_biomarker_requirement: DSRCT-defining EWSR1-WT1 mandatory; no EMC-compatible route.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol appendices unreviewed; prior-therapy and safety criteria preserved but no patient assessment.
quotes: Histological centrally confirmed diagnosis of DSRCT with the documented presence of EWSR1-WT1 translocation.

label: explicit_exclusion
rationale: Required Ewing pathology and explicit rejection of clear FET-non-ETS fusions exclude the EMC FET-NR4A3 route. EWSR1/FUS break-apart wording does not create an all-FET basket.
cohort_reconciliation: Liposomal irinotecan/VT and standard irinotecan/VT arms share the Ewing restriction and FET-non-ETS exclusion.
extra_biomarker_requirement: Ewing-specific FET gene break plus pathology required; EMC's non-ETS NR4A3 partner does not satisfy the class restriction.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol unreviewed; NOT_YET_RECRUITING snapshot. No inference about actual partner testing or an individual diagnosis.
quotes: clear FET-non ETS fusions (such as EWSR1-WT1, EWSR1-NFATC2, EWSR1-PATZ1, etc.) do not meet the enrollment criteria.

label: insufficient_evidence
rationale: Uncomplicated aortic-dissection study contains no EMC tumor-scope evidence. Life expectancy below two years is a clinical condition, not evidence about an EMC patient's prognosis.
cohort_reconciliation: Medical therapy alone and TEVAR plus medical therapy both concern uncomplicated type-B aortic dissection; no oncology arm.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol unreviewed; comorbid cancer applicability cannot be established from expected-survival restriction. Trial background estimates are not scientific findings of this round.
quotes: with an uTBAD of less than four weeks duration.
Subjects with a clinically estimated life expectancy

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: EMC is expressly in the closed eligible sarcoma list; exclusion of other sarcoma subtypes does not negate its named inclusion.
cohort_reconciliation: Single cirtuvivint sarcoma arm includes EMC; two desmoid proof-of-concept patients at one hospital are separately outside total n, not a general expansion.
extra_biomarker_requirement: Mandatory central pathology/tumor and blood samples, but no additional molecular alteration is stated.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol unreviewed. Prior anthracycline requirement has an SFT exception, not an automatic EMC exception; line limits, recent progression and sampling constraints remain. No efficacy conclusion.
quotes: Sarcoma subtypes other than the specified in the inclusion criteria.
